children: MARA Holdings entered into a First Amendment to its Membership Interest Purchase Agreement for MAT 1177, refining milestone payments and adding optionality around project advancement. The amendment keeps the total potential purchase price at $600 million, restructures regulatory-related milestones, increases payments tied to power authorization, and removes reversion provisions in favor of a sale process with a right of first offer to the seller. MARA also posted a $100 million security deposit with the electric utility for 2,000 MW capacity, which it may withdraw at its discretion.
